title: Rotation (shared definitions)
description: The root rotation of a key pose: Euler degrees intrinsic XYZ, right-handed (Q6), the declared turn and its axis (flip about X, spin about Y, cartwheel about Z: Q5, O32). Shared by the S13 motion plan and the motion graph (owner O65); embedded where used by kernel/shared_schemas.py.

EulerXYZ.description: Root Euler degrees [X, Y, Z], intrinsic XYZ, right-handed; continuous per entity (never wrapped).
